Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost — if the new iPhone has a different size from the old one, you'll need to buy a new case too.

For anyone upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, it would seem almost certain they'd need a new case, but two accessory makers disagree — and one of them is betting big on that claim...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter showing an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, saying the case is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

for iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself wasn't too confident, adding a comment saying "it's too early." But Matt Ronge from Astropad — which makes anti-reflective screen protectors for iPhones — said his suppliers told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker claimed that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier suggested the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimetres thicker than the previous generation.

This trend is consistent with previous developments, as both models of the iPhone 17 Pro were thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree — one has said the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's view

Apple does sometimes give size information to reputable case manufacturers ahead of time, so third-party cases can launch at the same time as new iPhones. But on the other hand, sometimes accessory makers just gamble based on rumours, and sometimes they get it wrong. Personally, I wouldn't pre-order a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
